images.caption: Replica of Fort Clatsop. The Corps of Discovery stayed on this site through the winter of 1805-1806, living largely off trading with the local American Indians. The Corps of Discovery was a big coup for American empire-building, but it signalled the beginning of hardship and danger for the American Indian peoples of the west. Lewis & Clark National Historic Park, Oregon & Washington
